row:
At ELM Cat Rescue, our rescues are our inspiration. We learn from them, admire their acceptance, and follow their lead. We don't discriminate and we don't judge. Some come to us healthy and socialized; others need urgent care. Many have no trust for humans. We spend countless hours bottle feeding, administering medications, providing fresh food and water, and clean litter boxes - all on top of the constant running of our washing machine. We open our hearts to every personality; laid back, rambunctious, skittish, cuddly, and feral. We accept every age from newborn to senior, both genders, and we will take in any breed or colour.

We do this as mothers of children, working full or part time, volunteering, and battling our own private matters. We have often been commended for our care and ongoing support to our adoptive families. With all this in mind however, we are nothing without our "village". It is because of all our supporters that we are able to continue doing all that we do
